segments.name: Internet hospital
segments.description: Provides online follow-up consultations, online prescription renewal, and sells prescriptions to customers via its website and apps.
segments.evidence: The Internet hospital segment includes providing online follow-up consultations and online prescription renewal service to customers and also sells prescription to customers through the Group's website and apps.

segments.name: Pharmaceutical supply chain
segments.description: Runs pharmacy retail sales of medicines to retail customers and wholesale supply to drug vendors, hospitals and its own drugstores.
segments.evidence: The pharmaceutical supply chain segment includes pharmacy retail sales and wholesale.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for online consultations and prescriptions, and retail customers, drug vendors and hospitals pay for medicines.
revenueModel.evidence: The pharmacy retail sales sell prescription and over-the-counter ("OTC") medicines, TCM and others to retail customers.
